verdict.rationale: Vercel runs a public Atlassian Statuspage at vercel-status.com with an incident history feed and permanent per-incident pages. Each page carries a dated Investigating/Identified/Resolved timeline, so a devops lead can review past incidents before committing. However, the evidence shows only status-update timelines, not root-cause postmortem write-ups. missing for 10: documented postmortem/RCA reports attached to historical incidents, independent or hands-on corroboration of the status page's depth.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can check a public status page with historical incident postmortems before committing

citations.quote: Vercel's public status page (Atlassian Statuspage) publishes an incident history feed titled "Vercel Status - Incident History" at vercel-status.com, with dated per-incident timelines (Investigating/Identified/Resolved updates) and permanent incident pages
